summary: No registry of planarian strains exists in the places searched; the planarian side is reachable only through a literature census (PubMed: 31 records matching planarian plus transgenesis terms). FlyBase and MGI are the natural contrast catalogues but only their landing pages were checked, and the Alliance search API returned zero for every query tried.
next_step: Run a documented PubMed/Europe PMC census of planarian heritable-line papers, classify each by origin, and pull morphology-phenotype allele counts for fly and mouse from FlyBase and MGI (their own query tools) before pre-registering.
obstacles_confirmed: Absence of reports is not proof of absence.
No single database covers planarian strains.
